commit.message:
8392223: CLDR provider mutates shared cached time zone name arrays

CLDRTimeZoneNameProviderImpl.getDisplayNameArray() fixes up missing
names in the array returned by LocaleResources.getTimeZoneNames(), which
is the instance stored in the LocaleResources cache and handed to every
caller. Derived values (last-resort GMT format, region format, COMPAT
substitutions in the update releases) therefore end up in shared state.

On mainline this makes a display name depend on lookup order: a value
derived for a parent locale is inherited by a later child-locale lookup
through the parent-locale check in deriveFallbackName() instead of being
derived for the child. In 11u/17u/21u the same write races between
threads on the first lookup and can replace a valid short name with a
GMT offset for the life of the process.

Copy the array before the fix-up so the cached instance stays pristine.
